reviews.name: Imran
reviews.text:
I rarely write reviews, but this course truly deserves one.

An amazing course by Hamza and the entire team. It has taken my understanding of Claude and AI workflows to the next level. The content is practical, well-structured, and packed with real-world examples that you can apply immediately.

What impressed me the most is that the team continuously updates the course as the AI landscape evolves. Things change incredibly fast in AI, and it's reassuring to know the course stays current instead of becoming outdated.

Another huge bonus is the amount of free resources they provide. Honestly, many of those resources alone are worth a significant amount and add tremendous value beyond the course itself.

Before enrolling, I spent a lot of time comparing courses on Maven and other platforms. After reviewing many options, I chose this one—and it was absolutely the right decision. The quality of the content, the ongoing updates, and the commitment to student success set it apart.

Congratulations to Hamza and the entire team for creating such a fantastic course. I highly recommend it to anyone looking to seriously level up their Claude and AI skills.

reviews.name: Tarik
reviews.text:
I took Claude Code in Practice and I'm extremely satisfied with the experience. Hamza and Aishwarya make a fantastic teaching duo — clear, approachable, and genuinely passionate about what they teach.

The course is very well structured, with a logical progression that lets you build skills without ever feeling lost. The practical exercises are particularly well designed — you learn by doing, and the examples are relevant to real-world use cases.

One thing I especially appreciated: the course is fully accessible to non-technical people. You don't need to be a developer to follow along and get real value out of it — that's a genuine strength.

Hamza and Aishwarya are also responsive and available to answer questions, which makes a real difference. And the community around the course is active and supportive — a great bonus.

Highly recommended, whether you're technical or not. This is an excellent entry point for anyone looking to get hands-on with Claude Code.

reviews.name: Bilal
reviews.text:
As a leader in Data Science, the transition from seasoned Data Scientist to AI Engineer was always on the cards — the only question was when. Claude Code in Practice was my first course on using Claude Code, and it helped me get there while opening my eyes to a whole new world of possibilities.
The course goes far beyond the basics. It walks you through setting up subagents to handle specialized tasks in parallel, crafting effective CLAUDE.md files to give Claude the right context, and designing custom slash commands and hooks that streamline repetitive workflows. I learned how to orchestrate multi-agent systems that can research, code, test, and review — all while I focus on the bigger picture. The MCP integrations alone unlocked workflows I didn't even know were possible.
The impact was immediate. I became 10X more productive at work, shipping AI and Data Science products with an ease I had never experienced before. Features that would have taken weeks now take days. Prototypes that would have remained on the whiteboard are now in production. From data pipelines to LLM-powered applications, Claude Code has become my co-pilot for building and shipping at speed.
If you're serious about evolving into an AI Engineer and want to ride the wave rather than watch it pass, this course is your gateway to harnessing AI and riding the tide.

reviews.text: Built a full AI-powered product in four weeks using multi-agent Claude architecture. What impressed me most: the hands-on approach. Hamza teaches you how to think about breaking complex problems into focused agents that talk to each other. I shipped IronMind (4 agents orchestrating a daily habit companion) with a working backend and full UI. The capstone structure forces you to understand what you built deeply enough to explain it - that's the real skill. If you want to learn Claude Code seriously, not just toy projects, this course is the one.

reviews.name: Yousuf
reviews.text:
Hamza starts from scratch and builds your mental model properly before asking you to use anything. By the time you're running sub-agents, you understand why the architecture works — you're not just copy-pasting commands.

What makes this different is it doesn't stop at concepts. You learn skills, slash commands, and orchestration — but you also see what they actually enable. 

You come unfamiliar with Claude Code. and leave with Sprint Zero — a cloneable kit that takes any company URL and, through a chain of sub-agents, produces a full product spec and working codebase in one command.

reviews.name: Alok
reviews.text:
Hamza's Claude Code in Practice is one of the most useful Claude Code courses out there.
He doesn't rehash the docs. The focus is on the workflow patterns that actually move the needle - CLAUDE.md design, hooks, MCP servers, locking down permissions, breaking work into subagents, and knowing when to step in vs. let the agent run. Every session is built around real problems he's solved.
If you're a developer or PM and want to learn about getting more out of Claude Code, take this course. You'll leave with a setup you'll actually use.
